# Served at the domain root via conf.py html_extra_path (overrides the
# Read the Docs autogenerated robots.txt, which allows everything).
# The ~60 autogenerated _modules/ source-view pages are thin duplicates of
# the API reference - keep them out of crawlers so search engines surface
# the documented pages instead.

Disallow: /en/*/_modules/
